mapper.select: /* 양도 게시글 등록 시 선택한 계약 정보 조회 */ SELECT rc.rental_contract_no , p.products_nm , p.model_no , p.item_no , product_category_no , sp.sell_products_no , rc.sell_products_no , rc.contract_quantity , rc.contract_period, rc.rental_start_date , rc.rental_end_date , CEIL(DATEDIFF(rc.rental_end_date, NOW()) / 30) AS remaining_months, sp.final_price , di.del_info_no , dl.delivery_addr FROM rental_contract rc LEFT JOIN sell_products sp ON rc.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no INNER JOIN products p ON sp.products_no = p.products_no INNER JOIN delivery_information di ON rc.cust_id = di.cust_id INNER JOIN delivery_list dl ON di.delivery_location_no = dl.delivery_location_no WHERE rc.cust_id = 'corpcustid4' AND rc.rental_contract_no = #{rentalContractNum};

/* 양도 게시글 등록 클릭 시 유효한 렌탈 목록 조회 */ SELECT rc.rental_contract_no , p.products_nm , rc.contract_period FROM rental_contract rc LEFT JOIN sell_products sp ON rc.sell_products_no = sp.sell_products_no INNER JOIN products p ON sp.products_no = p.products_no WHERE rc.cust_id = 'corpcustid4';

/* 내 양도 게시글 목록 조회 (제목, 작성자, 상품명, 이미지)*/ SELECT tb.transfer_board_no , p.products_image , tb.cust_id , c.cust_nm , pc.middle_category , pc.small_category , tb.transfer_title , tb.rental_fee , tb.individual_grants , tb.transfer_rental_processing_status , DATE(tb.register_date) AS register_date FROM customer c RIGHT JOIN transfer_board tb USING (cust_id) INNER JOIN sell_products sp USING (sell_products_no) INNER JOIN products p USING (products_no) INNER JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no WHERE transfer_rental_processing_status != '양도공개전' AND tb.cust_id = 'personalcustid4' ORDER BY tb.register_date DESC;

/* 전체 행 수 */ SELECT COUNT(tb.transfer_board_no) FROM transfer_board tb INNER JOIN sell_products sp USING (sell_products_no) INNER JOIN products p USING (products_no)
p.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')

/* 양도 게시글 정보 조회 */ SELECT tb.transfer_board_no, tb.transfer_title, tb.transfer_rental_processing_status, dl.delivery_addr, tb.cust_id, p.products_nm , tb.board_valid_date, tb.remaining_months , tb.rental_fee, tb.individual_grants, tb.transfer_content FROM products p RIGHT JOIN sell_products sp USING (products_no) INNER JOIN delivery_information di USING (sell_products_no) INNER JOIN delivery_list dl USING (delivery_location_no) INNER JOIN transfer_board tb USING (del_info_no) WHERE tb.transfer_board_no = #{transferBoardNum};

/* 양도 게시글 목록 조회 (제목, 작성자, 상품명, 이미지)*/ SELECT tb.transfer_board_no , f.file_path AS upload_image , tb.cust_id , c.cust_nm , pc.middle_category , pc.small_category , tb.transfer_title , tb.rental_fee , tb.individual_grants , tb.transfer_rental_processing_status , DATE(tb.register_date) AS register_date FROM customer c RIGHT JOIN transfer_board tb USING (cust_id) INNER JOIN sell_products sp USING (sell_products_no) INNER JOIN products p USING (products_no) INNER JOIN products_category pc ON p.product_category_no = pc.product_category_no LEFT JOIN files f ON tb.transfer_board_no = f.ref_id AND f.file_type = 'mainImage'
transfer_rental_processing_status != '양도공개전'
AND p.products_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchValue}, '%')
ORDER BY
tb.rental_fee ASC,
tb.rental_fee DESC,
DATEDIFF(tb.board_valid_date, NOW()) ASC,
tb.register_date DESC LIMIT #{pageable.rowPerPage} OFFSET #{pageable.offset};
